name: Painting
summary: Interior and exterior painting for homes and commercial properties, including surface preparation, drywall repairs, caulking, priming, trim, doors, cabinets, siding, fascia and durable finish coatings.
features: Exterior siding, fascia and soffit painting

faqs.question: What preparation is included before painting?
faqs.answer: Preparation may include protecting floors and furnishings, cleaning surfaces, patching drywall, sanding, scraping loose coatings, caulking gaps and applying primer where needed.

faqs.question: When is primer necessary?
faqs.answer: Primer is commonly recommended over new drywall, repairs, stains, bare wood, major color changes and surfaces where adhesion or sealing must be improved.

faqs.question: Do you paint occupied homes and active commercial spaces?
faqs.answer: Yes. Work areas, access, ventilation and daily cleanup can be coordinated to reduce disruption while the property remains occupied or in operation.

faqs.question: Can exterior painting include siding, fascia, soffits and trim?
faqs.answer: Yes. Exterior scopes can include siding, fascia, soffits, doors, trim and other approved surfaces after repairs and preparation are completed.
